# UrbanXklusives (UXK)

> UrbanXklusives is the home of the $50 submissions — a Toronto-born indie
> music platform and blog. Since 2008. More than hip-hop: a multicultural
> home for music, art and roots.

- Main site: https://urbanxklusives.com/
- Submit music: https://urbanxklusives.com/#submit
- Contact: urbanxklusives@gmail.com
- YouTube: https://youtube.com/@urbanxklusives
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/urbanxklusives and https://instagram.com/therealtravmane
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/urbanxklusives
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@urbanxklusives
- X: https://x.com/UrbanXklusives
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/trav-mane-719a3ba2

## What UXK is

- Indie artist promotion: artists submit a song, video or brand for $50 and get
  a guaranteed permanent post with video and a social blast. Kids, beginners
  and disabled creators welcome. Mixtape placement is NOT included in the $50
  submission — mixtape slots are offered separately during registration windows.
- UR XKLUSIVE KONNECT: the visual mixtape series (Vol. 1 out now; Vol. 2
  coming; Vol. 3 submissions open), posted FREE — never sold. The $50
  submission is the website entry only, never a mixtape-placement guarantee
  (placement is separate, registration windows only). Featuring Sean Paine,
  Tony Moxberg, Raw Hype da Major, Breadwinner Kane, Hanif J Williams and more.
- The Q Files: tribute to Q, founder of WorldStarHipHop, who met founder
  Trav Mane in Toronto during NBA All-Star Weekend 2016.
- Tell Your Story: community storytelling for artists, kids, survivors and warriors.
- Shop: UXK merch ($65–$85) — checkout opens at launch; add to cart saves your pick for now. https://urbanxklusives.com/#shop

## Hero and headliner

- Xklusive is the UXK headliner: Jamaican dancehall artist, breakout
  "Big Money Poppin" (2016), known to fans as Broomy.
  https://urbanxklusives.com/#post-xklusive-mascot

## Founder

Trav Mane (Trav), Toronto, Canada. Founded UrbanXklusives in 2008 as
"home of the $50 submissions" to give inner-city youth a platform. The brand
was built in memory of Rainman. Motto: "Positivity over negativity" and
"Local support with global reach." Trav Mane is a Level 8 Google Local Guide —
his Google Maps reviews and photos have millions of views.
